mgmt_bio.text: Martin Pibworth became Chief Executive of SSE plc on 17 July 2025, having joined the company in 1998 as an energy trader and progressed through a series of commercial roles, becoming Managing Director, Energy Portfolio Management in 2012. In 2014 he was appointed Managing Director, Wholesale, taking responsibility for SSE's electricity generation portfolio and associated capital investment programme, overseeing the development of its flexible generation fleet and growing renewables. He joined SSE's Executive Committee in 2012 and its Board in 2017. As chief commercial officer, his most recent role before the top job, he oversaw SSE's Renewables, Thermal, Energy Markets and Energy Customer Solutions businesses.

sentences.quote: Today's announcement follows a robust succession process, led by SSE Chair Sir John Manzoni and the Nomination Committee with the support of independent recruitment specialists Korn Ferry.
sentences.text: Pibworth, a near-30-year SSE insider who ran the wholesale and commercial businesses, became chief executive after the July 2025 AGM following a board-led succession process run by the Nomination Committee with external search support.

mgmt_team_view.text: Pibworth, a near-30-year SSE insider who ran the wholesale and commercial businesses, became chief executive after the July 2025 AGM following a board-led succession process run by the Nomination Committee with external search support. In his first full year, to March 2026, SSE invested GBP 3.6bn and said it met all financial and operational targets, with its fully funded GBP 33bn plan to 2030 under way, reporting adjusted EPS of 153.5p near the top of guidance and a dividend of 68.7p against 64.2p. Capital allocation is heavily tilted to regulated networks, about GBP 27bn of the GBP 33bn, concentrating execution risk in large transmission projects.

sentences.text: SSE plc is executing a fully funded five-year investment plan of around GBP 33bn to 2030, of which 80% is in networks, targeting regulatory asset base growth of around 25% a year to 2030.

sentences.quote: SSE's adjusted capital investment jumped 20% to 3.6 billion pounds
sentences.text: Capital expenditure is set to rise above GBP 5bn in 2026/27, after a 20% increase to a record GBP 3.6bn in fiscal 2026.

Management reiterates adjusted EPS guidance of 168-193 pence for 2026/27 and 225-250 pence for 2029/30, backed by a progressive dividend policy targeting 5-10% annual growth and a 2025/26 full-year dividend of 68.7 pence.
Roughly 80% of EBITDA is expected to be index-linked by FY30, up from about 60% in FY26, with over 90% of debt at fixed rates.

sentences.quote: Adjusted net debt and hybrid capital at GBP 10.1bn, in line with expectations given increasing investment, with 3.3x net debt / EBITDA
sentences.text: Leverage stood at 3.3x net debt to EBITDA at March 2026, within thresholds for reaffirmed investment grade ratings.

thesis_pillars.text: Capital expenditure is set to rise above GBP 5bn in 2026/27, after a 20% increase to a record GBP 3.6bn in fiscal 2026. Leverage stood at 3.3x net debt to EBITDA at March 2026, within thresholds for reaffirmed investment grade ratings.
